item.title: Uncovering of the relics of St. Chrysostomos the Missionary in DR Congo
item.description: The rite was led by Patriarch Theodoros of Alexandria, together with hierarchs and clergy from other dioceses of the Patriarchate of Alexandria.

item.title: Bulgarian Patriarch and delegation make pilgrimage to St. Gabriel (Urgebadze)’s relics and cell
item.description: St. Gabriel’s relics are located at the Samtavro Monastery of the Transfiguration in Mtskheta, the ancient capital of Georgia.

item.title: “There’s no authentic Christianity without asceticism,”—Romanian Archbishop of Great Britain
item.description: Turning to the broader meaning of fasting, the Archbishop called Great Lent a universal invitation to holiness.

item.title: Greek clergy group criticizes Council of State ruling on same-sex marriage and adoption
item.description: The Holy Association of Greek Clergy (ISKE) has issued a statement criticizing the recent Council of State decision reaffirming the constitutionality of same-sex marriage and adoption in Greece.

item.title: 1,400th anniversary of Akathist hymn, “an intricately woven work of Divinely inspired theology”—Constantinople
item.description: Patriarch Bartholomew and the Holy Synod of Constantinople issued an encyclical marking the 1,400th anniversary of the first solemn standing chanting of the Akathist Hymn, commemorating the deliverance of Constantinople from the siege of the Avars and Persians in 626 AD.

item.title: Church at St. Serge Institute in Paris designated historical monument
item.description: The Church of St. Sergius of Radonezh at the St. Serge Institute in Paris has been designated a historical monument by the French Ministry of Culture, with a ceremony marking the occasion scheduled for Sunday, April 19.

item.title: ROCOR church in Ontario launches expansion project
item.description: The current expansion project is described as a historic moment in the life of the parish.

item.title: Seven monastic tonsures at Jordanville in final week of Great Lent
item.description: The rite was led by monastery abbot His Grace Bishop Luke of Syracuse.

item.title: Russian intelligence accuses Constantinople of meddling in Georgian Patriarchal succession
item.description: The Holy Synod of the Georgian Orthodox Church is expected to convene on Friday to discuss organizational matters related to the upcoming Patriarchal election.

item.title: The Lord Should Come First. Igumen Cyprian (Parts)
item.description: Igumen Cyprian (Parts), the father-confessor of the Moscow Sretensky Monastery, answers some questions about spiritual life.

item.title: Orthodox church in Tehran damaged by missile strikes
item.description: The Russian Home for the Elderly, located on the grounds adjacent to the cathedral, also suffered significant damage, including a partially collapsed roof. Elderly residents continue to live at the facility as dependents.

item.title: Filming on Greek TV series about St. Joseph the Hesychast to begin after Pascha
item.description: The series will reveal little-known aspects of the saint’s ascetic life

item.title: Metropolitan Saba leads seminarian pilgrimage to St. Dumitru Romanian Orthodox Monastery in New York
item.description: Approximately 80 clergymen, seminarians, and their families joined the Metropolitan on a daylong pilgrimage to St. Dumitru Romanian Orthodox Monastery in Middletown, New York, on Friday.

item.title: Maryland parish receives hand-forged cross from Romanian orphanage it has long supported (+VIDEO)
item.description: The cross was presented to Holy Archangels as a gesture of gratitude for the parish’s sustained dedication to the orphanage.

item.title: Greek Metropolitan condemns state ruling on gay marriage and adoption
item.description: Metropolitan Chrysostomos of Mani of the Orthodox Church of Greece has strongly criticized the recent decision by Greece’s Council of State upholding the constitutionality of gay civil marriage and adoption, raising theological, legal, and social objections to both the ruling and the underlying legislation.
